name: Ronak Shah
player_statement:
A complete player, Ronak Shah has made a big mark in cricket. With 100 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 51, with an average of 14.92 and a quick strike rate of 159.40. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 86 sixes and 70 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 191.1 overs, taking 68 wickets at an economy rate of 8.07. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
